data.narrative:
Mara is a pre-seed stage company in Defense & Security founded by Daniel Kofman and Sriram Raghu, having raised $1.6M to date. The Defense & Security sector contains 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers, including later-stage companies such as Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems.

Two standard valuation methods were evaluated. The Stage-Progression approach was deemed inapplicable because the implied base value of $300M, when stepped forward by a 2.5x multiplier for pre-seed progression, yielded a $750M valuation—over 20x the company's total capital raised. This magnitude disparity suggests data integrity issues in the base input and renders the method unreliable. The Peer-Median method also could not be applied due to insufficient comparable volume: while 24 companies operate within the Defense & Security sector, fewer than three peers met narrow criteria for stage-matching and valuation-tier similarity. The top private peers identified operate at substantially later stages, making direct median application misleading.

Given these constraints, a quantitative valuation range cannot be responsibly derived from the available data. The analysis is limited by the absence of viable same-stage or tightly comparable private transactions and an inapplicable public-market baseline. Further data collection on earlier-stage Defense & Security fundraises and clarification of the stage-progression base case would be necessary to support a defensible range.
